lp = list(r.output['pose_world']) if r.ok else [-0.3,-0.31,0.94,0.7,0,0,0.714]
r = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag='right')
rp = list(r.output['pose_world']) if r.ok else [0.306,-0.313,0.941,0.7036,0,0,0.7106]
print('L0', [round(v,3) for v in lp[:3]], 'R0', [round(v,3) for v in rp[:3]])

def readp(tag):
    global lp, rp
    r = primitives.call(name='inspect_robotwin2_arm_pose', arm_tag=tag)
    if r.ok:
        p = list(r.output['pose_world'])
        if tag == 'left':
            lp = p
        else:
            rp = p
    return lp if tag == 'left' else rp

def vec(tag, x, y, z, g):
    if tag == 'left':
        return [x,y,z,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],g, rp[0],rp[1],rp[2],rp[3],rp[4],rp[5],rp[6],1.0]
    return [lp[0],lp[1],lp[2],lp[3],lp[4],lp[5],lp[6],1.0, x,y,z,q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],g]

def goto(tag, x, y, z, g, n=6, rounds=2, tol=0.03):
    d = 9.0
    for rd in range(rounds):
        for i in range(n):
            r = primitives.call(name='submit_robotwin2_ee_action', action=vec(tag,x,y,z,g), action_type='ee', evidence_handles=h1)
            if not r.ok:
                print('  ee_fail', str(r.output)[:120])
                return 9.0
        p = readp(tag)
        d = ((p[0]-x)**2 + (p[1]-y)**2 + (p[2]-z)**2) ** 0.5
        print('  ', tag, [round(v,2) for v in (x,y,z)], 'got', [round(v,3) for v in p[:3]], 'd', round(d,3))
        if d < tol:
            break
    return d
